main_text.p: lepticis, valetudinariis, cancris, arboribus, herbis, fru-ti, & aliis innumeris fatis superque docet, hæc inferiora non vno modo affici à superioribus. Neque tamen hoc ita est accipiendum, quasi corpora cœlestia vim habeant in omnia inferiora, vel quod sine discrimine & æqualiter 5agant in hunc mundum sublunarem. Non ita est. Nam primò stellæ in ea tantum agunt & agere possunt, quæ ἀπροαιρέτως[?] naturæ modo ac lege fiunt atque gubernantur: cuiusmodi sunt aër, mineralia, plantæ, & animalia quatenus animalia. Est enim earum rerum gubernatio 10omnis merè παθητικῶς[?], & naturæ ordinario vinculo & legi adstricta. Quæ verò pendent à merâ hominis προαιρέσει[?], vel à supernaturali gratiâ Dei, illa non subijciuntur astris. Deinde corpora cœlestia in res naturales non agùt eodem modo. Nam in quibusdam excitant duntaxat ia-15centes in ipsis vires, & semina actionum latentia corroborant, in quibusdam qualitates inditas conturbant, in quibusdam novas vires gignunt & multiplicem temperiem vel intemperiem iis imprimunt.20
main_text.head: BOTANICA SACRA.
main_text.p: I. BOtanica sacra est physica specialis de plan-tis, sumta ex sacris literis.25

II. Planta est corpus animâ vegetante præ-ditum: estque herba, vel arbor. Hæc distributio occurrit Gen. 1. v. 11. vbi herbæ diuiduntur in herbulas & herbas femen proferentes, h.e. in voluntarias seu insatiuas, quæ sponte suâ proueniunt, & satiuas, quæ cultu-ram hominis requirunt.30 Sub arboribus continentur frutices siue arbusta, & suffrutices. page.notes: Marginal numbers 5 to 35 are line markers in the right margin, kept as notes. The Greek words ἀπροαιρέτως, παθητικῶς and προαιρέσει are doubtful at the scan resolution and are marked [?]. The page is a scan with slight tilt; the word "fru-ti" is read from a partly hidden line end. The catchword "nam" sits lower right, below the last full line. The "20" note stands beside the end of the first paragraph. The printed "BOTANICA SACRA." heading is in spaced capitals. The "I." and "II." paragraphs are numbered theses and are therefore plain paragraphs. The drop cap B of "Botanica" is joined to its word.
